list.description: Author Authority Relations (ARF) that make soft decision authority explicit and agent-callable. Each relation carries a DNA-Coefficient — a divergence measure where 0.0 is best — computed from bound evidence, and becomes active only once it is within its threshold and fully affirmed.

details.activationRequires: Activation requires the DNA-Coefficient to be measured and within its ceiling ({{threshold}}), and every required affirmation completed{{affirmed}}.
details.cardReviewers: Reviewers (interviewed to confirm the relation reflects reality)
details.noCriteria: No criteria — the gate is unconstrained (approves any request).
details.noPrerequisites: None — this AR decides without walking any upstream gate.
details.noResourceRefs: None — canonical fields read directly from the AR row.
details.versionDialogDescription: Snapshots this Authority Relation into a new draft version. The rule, criteria, participants, evidence and domains are copied; measured DNAco and usage counters reset.
details.testDialogDescription: Dry-run against this Authority Relation's decision logic — works in any status and does not record the decision or change the usage counters. Live decisions come from the MCP resolve_authority tool against an active AR.

hints.slug: Stable key agents use to call this AR. Shared by every version of the family.
hints.authorityRelation: The ARF tuple: who (actor role + signing identity) may perform which action on which object.
hints.dnaMaxThreshold: The divergence ceiling. The DNA-Coefficient measures how far past decisions diverge from this rule (0.0 = perfect match, higher = worse). The AR can be activated only while its measured value stays at or below this ceiling; an active AR that later drifts above it is auto-flagged Needs Review.
hints.mcpResolverCredentials: OBO: MCP tools run with the caller's own permissions; a caller without a forwarded token gets no_authority. App service principal: tools run as the Ontos app for every caller, so the result no longer depends on who is asking. Only use this when the tool must see data callers cannot.
hints.mcpNoCallerToken: No caller token was forwarded, so this list was fetched as the Ontos app service principal. Callers of an OBO-authenticated AR may not have access to these services.

sectionDescriptions.decisionCriteria: Checks the gate enforces after the rule (and the DNA-Coefficient measures divergence against). Each is a reusable Compliance Check.
sectionDescriptions.evidenceSources: Bind the past decisions the DNA-Coefficient is measured against. Add one or more sources — a Delta table, a Data Product, or an Asset (volume file, table, or view). Each maps its columns to the canonical AR elements via the column map.
sectionDescriptions.participants: The N-functional gate and review. Approvers count toward the affirmation gate. Reviewers are interviewed during the review process to confirm the relation reflects reality. A principal can be both.
sectionDescriptions.requires: Prerequisite ARs: each must resolve approved before this one decides. Keyed by the family slug (not the version) so this AR keeps working when a prerequisite is version-bumped. Save requires this AR to carry a slug of its own.
sectionDescriptions.resourceRefs: Where field values come from. Instead of a plain literal, back a canonical field (actor_identity, object_id, domain_context.{{keyPlaceholder}}) with a typed pointer. An Ontos entity ref re-resolves against the knowledge graph at eval time so the value stays current when the underlying concept, product, or domain changes. MCP tool refs call a Unity Catalog MCP service at decision time; criteria can compare against the resolved value as obj.ref_{{fieldPlaceholder}} (dots become underscores, e.g. obj.ref_actor_identity).
sectionDescriptions.dnaSchedule: How often the DNA-Coefficient is recomputed against the evidence sources.
sectionDescriptions.domainContext: The bounded scope this authority holds in, and its parameters. A request outside the scope gets no_authority; the rule and the checks read the parameters as ctx.<key>.
sectionDescriptions.rule: What the authority permits, as ODRL: constraints that must hold, duties still to fulfil (the decision is conditional until then, e.g. a co-approval) and prohibitions. Compare with values or variables (ctx.threshold, req.market).
sectionDescriptions.justification: The policy version this authority derives from and the clauses it implements. Resolve refuses when the policy is not approved, withdrawn or outside its effective dates.

messages.dataProductNotYetSupported: Data Product sources are recorded but not yet read for DNAco (v1).

validation.roleRequiredDescription: Every participant with a principal must be bound to a Business Role (from Settings).
validation.principalRequiredDescription: Every participant with a role must have an email or group identifier.

validation.columnMapError: Column map for "{{ref}}" must be valid JSON.

criteria.description: Derived and aggregate predicates the rule doesn't express. The gate approves only when every check passes; a check that fails for a past decision counts as a divergence in the DNA-Coefficient, weighted and signed by its direction. Rules read the request as obj.<field> / req.<key> and the parameters as ctx.<param>.

fields.failureMessagePlaceholder: Denial message shown when this fails

extraSchemas.label: Extra schemas
extraSchemas.hint: catalog.schema, comma-separated, to search for MCP services. system.ai is always included.

params.label: Params (JSON)
params.hint: String values are Jinja templates over the request plus ar.*, e.g. {{exampleActor}}, {{exampleMarket}}.
params.errorNotObject: Params must be a JSON object.

resultPointer.label: Result pointer
resultPointer.hint: JSONPath into the tool response; $ is the whole response.

descriptions.off: No automatic recompute. The DNA-Coefficient updates only when you click Compute or edit the AR.
descriptions.scheduled: The scheduled recompute job runs it on this cadence (stored as {{cron}}).

errors.noReviewFound: No review found for you on this Authority Relation.

review.title: Request Review
review.description: Start the N-functional review: each assigned reviewer gets an Asset Review to confirm the relation reflects reality, and the review workflow is fired.

statusChange.title: Change Status
statusChange.description: Move this Authority Relation through its lifecycle. Activation requires the DNA-Coefficient to be measured within its ceiling and every required affirmation completed.

dialog.title: Request Action
dialog.description: Select the type of request you want to submit for this Authority Relation.

form.messagePlaceholder: Add any notes for the reviewers…

scope.label: Scope
scope.hint: Where this authority holds. The request context must carry each key with a matching value, otherwise the resolve returns no_authority (a missing key too). Keys are stored as ODRL operands (market → arf:market; spatial, purpose… keep their ODRL name).

params.label: Parameters
params.hint: Values the rule and the checks read as ctx.<key>, e.g. a threshold or the cleared markets. Change them here instead of editing every rule.

validation.title: Domain context is incomplete
validation.invalidKey: '{{key}}' is not a valid key: use letters, digits and _.

messagePlaceholder.duty: Message while the duty is pending

rule.variablesHint: Compare with a variable instead of a fixed value: ctx.<param> reads the AR's parameters, req.<key> the request and its context. Derived or aggregate logic belongs in the Compliance Checks below.
rule.rawJsonHint: This condition uses nested logic the editor can't show; edit it as ODRL JSON.

validation.title: Rule is incomplete
validation.badJson: A condition's ODRL JSON is not valid JSON.

rule.none: No rule: only the checks gate this authority.

list.title: Authority Policies
list.description: The documented basis an authority derives from: delegation-of-authority schedules, board mandates, regulations, procurement policies, SOPs and recorded exceptions. Authority Relations cite a policy version and the clauses they implement; a resolve without a valid policy root returns no authority.

editor.keyHint: Stable identifier shared by every version of the policy, e.g. POL-DOA.
editor.jurisdictionHint: The scope the policy covers, as JSON, e.g. {"market": ["DE", "AT"]}.

validation.title: The policy is not valid
validation.amount: A clause limit must be a number.

clauses.title: Clauses
clauses.hint: The citable provisions of the policy. Authority Relations cite the clauses they implement; rule items and checks cite the clause they enforce, and a denial names it.

details.withdrawnMsg: Active Authority Relations citing it now need review.
details.rootProblem: This version can't ground an authority now: {{problem}}.
details.noDocumentsDraft: No source documents yet. Upload them under Metadata below; each is stored with its SHA-256.
details.documentsImmutable: This version is no longer a draft: its documents are fixed evidence and change only through a new version.
details.noDependents: No Authority Relation cites this version.

approve.title: Approve {{key}} v{{version}}
approve.description: An approved version is immutable and can ground Authority Relations from its effective date.
approve.supersedesHint: Approving supersedes v{{version}}: it stays valid until this version takes effect.

withdraw.title: Withdraw {{key}} v{{version}}
withdraw.description: Authority Relations citing this version: {{count}}. Active ones are set to needs review, and none of them resolves until it cites a valid policy.

newVersion.title: New policy version
newVersion.description: Drafts a successor with the same clauses. Edit it, then approve it to supersede this version.

citation.problem: No valid policy root: {{problem}}. Resolves return no authority.
citation.notApprovedHint: This version is {{status}}: the Authority Relation won't resolve until it cites an approved, effective version.
